item.title: Galway medtech company gets EU regulatory approval for Vein Infusion device
item.description: InVera Medical, a Galway based medtech company, has received European regulatory approval for a new minimally invasive device designed to help physicians deliver treatment more effectively to diseased leg veins, including varicose veins. The approval, known as a CE Mark, allows the company’s InVera Infusion Device to be marketed and used across the European Union. […]

item.title: 6th world record for Paralympian Shane McLoughlin in Connemara
item.description: Paralympian and Amputee Shane McLoughlin broke his 6th world record this morning, Saturday, February 14, with a 5 meter pull of the 120 tonne Saoirse na Farraige, Aran Island Ferries largest vessel. item.title: Works begin on Galway City wastewater improvements to unlock new housing
item.description: Work is due to begin shortly on the development of improved wastewater pumping infrastructure on the east side of Galway City to allow further development of the area.
